source_identity_kind: Git blob SHA-1 from pinned publisher metadata; sources inspected as text, not executed
inference_findings: Higher fake score is 1-sigmoid(logit); training label 1 means real.
Publisher script peak-normalizes, repeats short audio and center-crops long audio to 80000 samples at 16 kHz.
Constructor automatically downloads microsoft/wavlm-large before loading the classifier checkpoint.
Publisher loader can fall back to unrestricted pickle deserialization and loads with strict=False. An isolated adapter must disable both behaviors.
Classifier checkpoint includes fine-tuned WavLM weights; existing XLSR weights cannot substitute.
decision: Deferred before weight acquisition; not tested or integrated. Respect the evaluation contract against automatic large downloads. Noncommercial license also prevents assuming unrestricted product redistribution.
fallback: Evaluate the already-installed pinned Wav2Vec2 classifier on exactly the existing 45-source, five-condition development screen, fixed default threshold 0.5, no tuning. This older local alternative does not test the publisher claims of the deferred noise-trained WavLM model.
